purpose: position/velocity feedback, derivative uncertainty, native and CAN tracking; NEXT only

endpoint_config.model_notice: 2026-10-16 待验收模型（最佳第12轮）；当前为真机只读观测。验证/测试仅覆盖6°/s，接触及卸载恢复尚未验证。

training_envelope.source: observed training positions only; rectangular bounds do not certify all pose combinations

feedback_protocol.role: independent diagnostic; never training or delay calibration

position_derivatives.edge_policy: exclude half-window at record boundaries; no differentiation across gaps >40ms

plateau_checks: encoder displacement divided by elapsed time
trapezoidal integral of reported velocity against encoder displacement
unshifted raw velocity and fixed-window position derivatives
feedback_protocol.raw_can_matching: latest preceding kernel RX per joint; report ages and disagreement, never shift
feedback_protocol.uncertainty: method sensitivity and quantization bounds, not calibrated physical confidence intervals
feedback_protocol.latency: do not estimate, fit or apply any new time shift on these independent data
feedback_protocol.static_analysis: last 8s of initial/final settle; all 7 feedback channels
